tldr: The Sun in Cancer: identity built through care, memory, and emotional belonging.
body: With the Sun in Cancer, the core self strengthens when you protect what matters and build spaces where tenderness can survive. You are here to trust emotional intelligence as real guidance.
gift: Nurturing leadership, intuition, loyalty, and the ability to create emotional safety.
challenge: Defensiveness, clinging, and caring for others while hiding your own needs.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
